# Level X

> Level X is a small independent mobile app studio building calm, careful apps
> for kids and families. Operated as Level X Consulting LLC.

Contact: https://levelxinc.com/#contact (contact form)
Website: https://levelxinc.com

## Apps

- Pausely: A mindfulness app for kids and families offering short, guided
  moments to pause, breathe, and reset together. Launching on Google Play.
  Category: mindfulness & wellness. Family-friendly, ages 4+.
- Prevail (in development): Gentle, forgiving habit-building. Category:
  habits & productivity.
- OffMyMind (in development): A calm space for couples to stay connected.
  Category: relationships & connection.

## How Level X works

- Independent studio, built and run solo.
- Privacy-first: follows Google Play Families and COPPA guidance. No data sold,
  no advertising aimed at children, no manipulative engagement patterns.
- Every app starts from a real moment in family life and aims to make it calmer.

## Writing

- The Level X blog publishes short essays on calm technology and building for
  families: https://levelxinc.com/blog/
